title: WireGuard server init and peer registration
description: Implement gophermind-server/wireguard.go: initialize WG interface at startup (per-backend or single), implement POST /wg/register endpoint (accepts gocloak token, validates, issues peer public key + config), manage peer lifecycle (add, remove, timeout). Wire into server startup/shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: WG interface is created at server startup
POST /wg/register accepts a valid gocloak token and returns peer config (public key, endpoint, allowed IPs)
Peer lifecycle: add, remove, timeout all work
Server shutdown closes WG interface cleanly
Integration test: register peer, verify config, test tunnel connectivity
